assessment: For concurrent or delayed byte-identical stage4 transactions against freshly verified stage3, at most one candidate function/catalog advancement can commit. A later guard failure, uniqueness conflict, lock/statement timeout or other SQL error aborts the unsuccessful transaction. No installed function body or provider operation is invoked.
conditions: Same exact SQL, guards, timeouts and transaction boundaries.
Fresh complete catalog/data/session/ACL preflight; no unrelated privileged concurrent writer.
Only the normal supported migration path; no altered destructive classification.
Every prior request remains recorded unknown until authoritative result/postflight, even if another identical transaction wins.
notAssessed: Retry safety for support, notification, another business stage or arbitrary future migrations.
Provider tool availability, internal confirmation presentation or journal implementation beyond normal supported behavior.
